description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-orchestrator skill

test_cases.name: Multi-Phase Lifecycle Orchestration
test_cases.description: Ensures orchestrator coordinates specialist handovers in order without bypassing spec or TDD phases.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate the end-to-end development of a real-time presence awareness feature.

test_cases.name: Claim Linear ticket on main
test_cases.description: When playing a Linear issue, orchestrator claims In Progress, assigns the host agent, stays on main uncommitted, and outputs a conventional commit subject with the ticket id.
test_cases.prompt: Work WAY-123: implement the handshake align pointers on main.

test_cases.name: PostHog intake then file-from-handover
test_cases.description: Orchestrator keeps PostHog intake on a findings handover (no Linear while posthog is the only profile), then restores default and files via user-stories and PRD when the row is a bet or larger than one sitting. No insights skill.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate pulling PostHog suggestions into tickets, then file the handover as Linear work.

required_patterns: do not invent an insights skill

test_cases.name: Error cluster and empty events skip the lifecycle
test_cases.description: An error cluster or empty events prompt routes to agent-debug or the empty-events checklist, not grill/PRD/stories/spec.
test_cases.prompt: PostHog shows an error cluster and empty events. Orchestrate the right route.
